inactive_components: Activated/triggered ability targets, including the mana-ability exception: only real spell targets are exercised.

recipes.oracle_text: Counter target spell, activated ability, or triggered ability. (Mana abilities can't be targeted.)

recipe_coverage: Complete source identity and Oracle text are pinned. Actual parent and response casts use stack1/stack2 and normal legality, payment and selection for both controllers. Tests cover printed fixed or derived taxes, pay/decline/exact/unaffordable decisions, source costs and missing resources, typed targets, own/opposing spells, selected/unselected permanents, exact zone multiplicities and ordered libraries, and snapshot replay as applicable. Activated/triggered ability targets, including the mana-ability exception: only real spell targets are exercised. Countered response sources, lost targets, replacement/prevention, simultaneous responses and multiplayer remain separate gaps.
